topic: Introduction to Holomorphic Dynamics: The Beauty of Iteration
target_audience: Undergraduate students in mathematics or physics

sections.title: Prerequisites: The Complex Plane and Functions
lecture_lines: Complex numbers are vectors in the plane.
Holomorphic functions map shapes while preserving angles.
Iteration means repeatedly applying the same function.
animations: Show Complex Plane with x and y axes in #FFFFFF.
Label Real and Imaginary axes with #FFD700 text.
Create a point z = a + bi in #00FFFF.
Flash the point z to highlight its location.
Show function f(z) = z^2 + c with #FFFFFF.

sections.title: Fixed Points and Attractors
lecture_lines: Fixed points are where the function remains unchanged.
Orbits track a point's movement under repeated iteration.
Stable fixed points attract nearby points like magnets.
animations: Display a point z_0 in the complex plane #FFFFFF.
Show the trajectory of points using a sequence of dots.
Highlight the attractor point where the sequence converges #00FF00.

sections.title: The Julia Set: Defining the Boundary of Chaos
lecture_lines: Julia sets define boundaries of dynamic behavior.
Small changes lead to vastly different outcomes.
These boundaries form complex, beautiful patterns.
Points flee to infinity or spiral toward attractors.
This sensitive dependence creates chaotic boundaries.
animations: Initialize the complex plane with a grid #FFFFFF.
Color points that diverge to infinity in #FF0000.
Color points that remain bounded in #0000FF.
Draw the boundary line clearly between the two regions.
Highlight the intricate edge of the Julia Set #FFFF00.

sections.title: The Mandelbrot Set: The Map of All Dynamics
lecture_lines: The Mandelbrot set maps all dynamic possibilities.
It determines if orbits remain bounded or diverge.
It showcases stunning self-similarity at every scale.
Mini-Mandelbrots appear throughout the main structure.
This set acts as the ultimate parameter map.
animations: Show the parameter c-plane in #FFFFFF.
Iterate the formula for different c values.
Color values of c resulting in a connected set.
Reveal the iconic cardioid shape of the set.
Zoom in to show the self-similarity of the set.

sections.title: Real-World Application: Fractal Growth
lecture_lines: Fractals model complex growth in nature.
Recursive rules simulate branching patterns efficiently.
Holomorphic dynamics reveal life's geometric beauty.
Simple rules produce incredible natural complexity.
Mathematics provides a lens to view biology.
animations: Show a simple geometric shape, like a triangle.
Apply the recursive rule to subdivide the shape.
Observe the emergence of a complex fractal pattern.
